concept.anti_generic_signature: Nine perfectly circular pockets bored straight down through a completely angular low-polygon boulder, with tall pointed teeth against squat all-square cube clusters, so the owner of every cell reads from directly overhead with no colour at all.
assumptions: One millimetre clearance means radial clearance on each side.
The 32 mm envelope describes the seated normal assembly; the held action state reaches 87 mm.
The two Wish reference images are concept art at an unstated camera and scale; where an image and a millimetre in the Wish disagree, the millimetre governs.

components.duty: Carries all nine circular growth sites on a 3 by 3 board.
components.form: Low-polygon fractured boulder. The plan is a closed polygon of 16 straight segments of unequal length, 12.69 mm shortest and 55.27 mm longest, with a bounding box of exactly 140.00 by 130.00 mm centred on the origin. The outer wall is 16 flat planes, one per segment, each leaning inward over the full 14.00 mm rise by 2.00 mm to 6.50 mm, that is 8 to 25 degrees from vertical; 7 of them are overtaken by their neighbours before the top, so the top edge is the angular chain those facets cut. The cavity wall is 32 flat triangles running from the rim opening at z 14.00 down to the field boundary at z 8.00, stepping inward 2.60 mm to 5.20 mm, that is 23 to 41 degrees from vertical. A flat rim band at z 14.00 is 3.12 mm wide at its narrowest. No spline surface, no fillet and no round-over anywhere; the bottom is one flat plane at z 0.00.

concept.design_spec:
# Shatterline - corrected Mara Masque handoff

Status: COMPLETE; construction may begin. Author: Mara Masque. This is a correction of the published Veinwake set (source artifact sha256 554e21777e8db2f278f21abc070d1e1533a493b5a95e10898b9420675c2caae4, snapshot sha256 9ce8801e80778249d5652372214c893eb072824c8bab5ac489c65e16f992baa3). The correction Wish changes exactly two of the three unique geometries and nothing else.

## What changed

1. make_rind() stops producing a smooth rounded pebble. rock_footprint()'s 64-point periodic superellipse spline is replaced by an explicit 16-segment polygon of unequal edge, the fillet(top, radius=ROCK_TOP_RADIUS) call is deleted, and the lower/upper terrace profiles are replaced by a triangulated cavity wall. ROCK_EXPONENT, ROCK_TOP_RADIUS, CAVITY_INSET, GROWTH_KEEPOUT_RADIUS, TERRACE_WIDTH and TERRACE_Z are retired with the mechanisms they served.
2. make_bubble() stops fusing three revolved lobes. bubble_lobe(), LOBE_RADIUS, LOBE_CENTER_RADIUS and LOBE_CROWN_Z are deleted and five interpenetrating cubes of unequal edge replace them. All four bubbles use this one geometry.

## What did not change

make_tooth() is untouched and its five exported STEP files reproduce the source archive's bytes exactly. Tic-tac-toe is played unchanged: nine cells, two players, alternate placement into any empty cell, first straight line of three wins, no capture, no movement, no removal, draw when the board fills with no line. Ten printed parts: one rind, five teeth, four bubbles. Every preserved constant in veinwake_lib.py keeps its exact value: BOARD_LENGTH 140.0, BOARD_WIDTH 130.0, RIM_HEIGHT 14.0, FIELD_HEIGHT 8.0, SEAT_DEPTH 2.0, SEAT_Z 6.0, GRID_PITCH 36.0, FOOT_DIAMETER 28.0, FOOT_HEIGHT 3.0, SEAT_CLEARANCE 1.0, SEAT_DIAMETER 30.0, CLUSTER_HEIGHT 26.0, ASSEMBLED_HEIGHT 32.0, HELD_OFFSET 55.0, DRAW_CELLS XOXXOOOXX. The nine seats stay at the Cartesian product of -36, 0 and +36 in both X and Y, stay 30.00 mm in diameter, stay 2.00 mm deep with their floors at z 6.00, and stay plain smooth-walled flat-bottomed cylinders. Colours stay on the same three PALETTE keys rind, tooth and bubble, and the two players stay visually opposed.

## Manufacturing envelope

FDM in opaque plastic on a 0.4 mm nozzle. Every part is fully opaque with no translucency in geometry or delivered colour. No feature is thinner than 3.00 mm: the only sub-millimetre regions either gate reports are edge tapers of 0.0 to 0.3 mm2 where two facets meet, which is the sharp edge every polyhedron has, against a median wall of 7.86 mm on the rind and 14.60 mm on the bubble. There are no needles, spikes, blades, fins, fur, grit, scattered micro-bumps or surface texture. All relief is large and flat-faced. No face overhangs more than 45 degrees from vertical; check_overhang at 45 degrees reports 0 regions needing support on all ten parts.
concept.interaction: Two players use rind, tooth_1, tooth_2, tooth_3, tooth_4, tooth_5, bubble_1, bubble_2, bubble_3 and bubble_4. Starting from empty pockets, alternate placing one own marker into any vacant site; teeth start. The first row, column or diagonal of one habit wins immediately; a full board without a line draws. Lift all markers to reset. The signature lowers tooth_3 by 55.00 mm into back-right to complete a back-row tooth line while four other active pieces stay fixed.
concept.print_stance: All ten parts upright on their own flat bottoms; no supports or hardware. Every part is fully opaque, no face overhangs more than 45 degrees from vertical, and no feature is a needle, spike, blade, fin or surface texture.
risks: Physical print, tactile handling and durability remain untested.
The operator disabled motion verification for this run, so seating and withdrawal are unverified rather than passed.
An unrelated fantasy fiction uses the earlier title string Veinwake; this revision publishes as Shatterline.
concept.signature_decision: Three exposed tooth peaks complete the fractured boulder's back ridge through one legal winning deposit, against cube clusters that can never be mistaken for them from any angle.
concept.summary: Tic-tac-toe as rival mineral growth: blunt tooth crystals and pyrite cube clusters fill a fractured geode, competing to form its first straight line.
concept.title: Shatterline

current_discussion.claim: Post and extensive recent tactical discussion directly retrieved. Title mentions 15,655 online games; relative timestamp shown as 8d ago in cached output.
current_discussion.limitation: Supports renewed discussion only, not sales, popularity ranking or validated data. Wish date 2026-08-26 not independently verified; no absolute date inferred.

design_changes.change: make_rind() produces a low-polygon fractured boulder: 16-segment angular plan, 16 flat outer wall facets at 8 to 25 degrees from vertical, and a 32-triangle faceted cavity wall.
design_changes.previous_choice: Periodic superellipse spline footprint at ROCK_EXPONENT 3.5, whole top edge filleted at ROCK_TOP_RADIUS 4.00 mm, and two faint cavity levels at z 8.00 and TERRACE_Z 11.00 with TERRACE_WIDTH 2.50 mm.
design_changes.reason: The correction Wish found the rock geological in its text and almost nowhere in its geometry: an evenly rounded pebble with no fracture, facet or edge, whose two cavity levels read as two faint arcs. Every outward and inward rock surface is now a flat planar facet meeting its neighbours at a sharp edge, and no spline, fillet or round-over survives.

design_changes.change: make_bubble() fuses 5 interpenetrating cubes of unequal edge in a pyrite habit.
design_changes.previous_choice: Three revolved lobes of identical LOBE_RADIUS 7.00 mm at LOBE_CENTER_RADIUS 6.00 mm, each a vertical cylinder wall capped by a hemisphere.
design_changes.reason: The correction Wish found three identical round-topped lobes read as pharmaceutical capsules and collapsed from directly overhead into a featureless rosette hard to tell from the tooth. The cube cluster is entirely flat square faces and sharp edges, squat against the tooth, and unmistakable from overhead.

design_changes.change: Cube orientations chosen so that no two cube faces fall nearly coincident.
design_changes.previous_choice: A first placement that left five sliver facets, the smallest 0.012 mm2.
design_changes.reason: Sliver facets read as blades in the canonical renders, which the manufacturing envelope forbids. The written solid now has 37 faces and its smallest is 5.77 mm2.

digital_rules_audit.scope: Exhaustive digital equivalence; no physical or human Playtest.

nearest_collisions.response: Deposition inside a geode with tactile mineral habits; no craft or product geometry copied.
No fungal silhouettes or brand styling; only ordinary game rules shared.

nearest_collisions.finding: Veinwake used as a fantasy disease name.
nearest_collisions.response: Retain Wish title; no lore borrowed and no unique-title or clearance claim.

research.novelty_claim: An unusual original combination; bounded search is not proof of universal novelty.

public_domain.bgg_limit: Wish-provided BGG URL inaccessible in this check; its Public Domain listing is not independently reverified.
public_domain.claim: Matching ordinary rules and explicit sitewide public-domain dedication directly verified.

revision.scope: Correction of the geode rind and the bubble marker only; the tooth, the rules and every preserved constant are untouched.

research.rule_audit: Zero specification differences under empty/X/O to empty/tooth/bubble bijection. Complete original rules and exact win/draw traces in concept.design_spec. Executable and physical checks remain separate.

rules_source.claim: Traditional two-player 3x3 alternate placement, row/column/diagonal immediate win, full-board draw verified.
rules_source.locator: Printed p.3, first traditional-game paragraph only

state_legibility.claim: Every cell owner is nameable from the canonical overhead render with no colour at all.
state_legibility.evidence: cad/veinwake/snap/top-neutral.png renders the complete assembly from directly above with every leaf material forced to one neutral grey. The tooth cells show one clean hexagon with a single small offset hexagonal tip; the cube-cluster cells show eight or more unequal angular facets at clearly different tones. The nine cells read XOX / XOO / OXX, matching DRAW_CELLS.
state_legibility.limitation: Digital render only; no human recognition test has been performed.
